# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster temporarily enchants a nonmagic, non-metal shield with a special bonus
of +10 to defensive bonus (DB).
@@ 2
Creates an invisible force shield in front of the caster. This functions as a
normal shield (subtracting 25 from appropriate attacks, etc.), except it does
not occupy a hand. This spell cannot be combined with a “real” shield.
@@ 3
Causes target to appear blurred to attackers. This subtracts 10 from all
attacks directed at the target.
@@ 4
Caster temporarily enchants one robe to confer a special bonus of +10 to DB.
@@ 5
Caster can deflect any one missile that passes within 100' of him (caster must
be able to see the missile). This causes 100 to be subtracted from the
missile’s attack.
@@ 6
Caster temporarily enchants one non-magic suit of leather (usually a shirt)
with a special bonus of +10 to DB.
@@ 7
Caster can deflect any one melee attack that he can see (and is within range).
This causes 50 to be subtracted from the attack.
@@ 9
As Deflections I, except 2 missiles may be affected.
@@ 10
Caster can deflect any one missile that passes within 100' of him (caster must
be able to see the missile). This causes the missile to automatically miss its
target.
@@ 11
As Bladeturn I, except 2 melee attacks may be affected.
@@ 13
As Deflections I, except 3 missiles may be affected.
@@ 15
As Aim Untrue I, except 2 missiles may be affected.
@@ 17
As Bladeturn I, except 3 melee attacks may be affected.
@@ 18
One missile passing within 100' of caster is reversed and make an attack on
its source. For the attack on the missile’s source, use an OB of +5 (no other
OB or DB modifiers apply).
@@ 19
As Aim Untrue I, except 3 missiles may be affected.
@@ 20
As Deflections I, except as many missiles as the caster’s level may be
affected.
@@ 25
As Bladeturn I, except as many melee attacks as the caster’s level may be
affected.
@@ 30
As Mass Deflections, except missiles automatically miss.
@@ 50
As Re-aiming, except all missiles passing within 100' of caster are reversed.
Each missile attacks its firer with a +20 OB.
